nodes.description: Contract owner address; set from msg.sender in constructor, receives 10% of totalmoney and is the only address allowed to change winnerLimit.
Mapping address => uint8[] holding the list of country IDs owned by each player; mutated on buy, attack and game reset.
Fixed size address[178] mapping country ID to its owner; written on buy/attack and cleared on game end.
Dynamic array of all addresses that ever bought a country; iterated in isGameEnd to look for a winner and cleared afterwards.
Accumulated Ether pot; incremented by msg.value on buy, split and reset to zero on game end.
Last pseudo-random roll derived from block.blockhash(block.number-1) modulo the combined country counts of attacker and defender.
Address of the winner of the most recently finished game.
Number of countries required to win the game; mutable only by the owner.
address[10] history array where slots 0-4 are winners and slots 5-9 are losers; shifted on every attack.
Caller-controlled address used as game player, attacker, buyer and owner-check subject.
Constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender.
Payable function that buys an unowned country for exactly 10 finney and records the player.
Attacks another player's country, resolves the fight with blockhash randomness, transfers country ownership and updates winner/loser history.
Checks whether a player reached winnerLimit, distributes the pot via two external transfers, then resets all game state.
Owner-only setter for the winnerLimit threshold.
Constant getter returning the whole ownerofCountry array.
Constant getter returning totalmoney.
Constant getter returning playerCountries[ax][bx].
Constant getter returning the number of countries owned by ax.
Constant getter returning lastR.
Constant getter returning the winnerloser history array.
Constant getter returning lastgameendWinner.
External Ether transfer of totalmoney/10 to the owner inside isGameEnd, executed before the pot and player arrays are reset.
External Ether transfer of totalmoney/10*9 to the winner inside isGameEnd, executed before the pot and player arrays are reset.
lastR = uint256(block.blockhash(block.number-1)) % (a+b); miner-influenceable pseudo-randomness that decides the fight outcome.
Unchecked indexing of the fixed array ownerofCountry[178] with a user supplied uint8 countryID (and later loop indices), which can read/write out of bounds.
totalmoney += msg.value performed without overflow protection (Solidity 0.4.x has no checked arithmetic).
isGameEnd iterates playerList with a uint8 counter compared against the uint256 playerList.length, allowing overflow/endless loop and truncation.
uint8 country identifier passed to buyCountry.
uint8 country identifier passed to attackCountry, selecting the target.
New winnerLimit value supplied by the owner to setwinnerLimit.
Local alias of msg.sender used throughout attackCountry.
Local address read from ownerofCountry[countryID] representing the defender.
Local loop bound in attackCountry, taken from the country list length of the losing player.
Local address in isGameEnd initialised to owner and overwritten by the first player reaching winnerLimit.
Local loop bound in isGameEnd equal to playerList.length.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the contract owner in the constructor.
Constructor writes the privileged owner state variable from the caller address.
msg.sender identifies the buyer and is pushed into playerList and ownerofCountry.
countryID parameter selects which country slot buyCountry fills.
Unvalidated countryID from the caller indexes the fixed array ownerofCountry[178].
buyCountry performs ownerofCountry[countryID] reads/writes without a bounds check.
Out-of-range index derived from user input reaches the ownerofCountry storage array.
buyCountry pushes countryID into playerCountries[msg.sender].
buyCountry sets ownerofCountry[countryID] = msg.sender.
buyCountry appends msg.sender to playerList.
buyCountry executes totalmoney += msg.value.
Unchecked addition of msg.value to the pot can overflow in Solidity 0.4.x.
msg.sender determines who attacks and which countries belong to the attacker.
countryID parameter selects the attacked country and its defender.
Unvalidated countryID indexes ownerofCountry[178] in attackCountry.
attackCountry indexes ownerofCountry and playerCountries with unvalidated values.
attacker local is assigned from msg.sender.
defender local is read from the ownerofCountry mapping.
attackCountry loopcount is derived from playerCountries lengths of attacker and defender.
attackCountry derives its fight result from block.blockhash(block.number-1).
lastR is written from miner-influenceable blockhash randomness that decides the winner.
attackCountry shifts and rewrites the winnerloser history array.
attackCountry moves country ID lists between attacker and defender and empties the loser list.
attackCountry reassigns ownerofCountry entries for all conquered countries.
attackCountry calls isGameEnd after every battle.
isGameEnd scans playerList to look for a player above winnerLimit.
loopcount_gameEnd is initialised from playerList.length.
winner is selected from an entry of playerList that owns at least winnerLimit countries.
isGameEnd uses a uint8 index to iterate a uint256-length list.
uint8 counter compared to playerList.length truncates/overflows and can loop forever.
isGameEnd performs the owner external transfer.
isGameEnd performs the winner external transfer.
External transfer happens before totalmoney is set to zero, leaving the pot state inconsistent.
External transfer to the winner occurs before the pot is reset, enabling re-entrant payout.
Recipient of owner.transfer can re-enter isGameEnd before player/pot state is cleared.
Winner contract can re-enter isGameEnd and drain the still-populated pot.
isGameEnd resets totalmoney to zero after distribution.
isGameEnd records lastgameendWinner.
isGameEnd clears playerCountries for every previously owned country.
isGameEnd zeroes the ownerofCountry array.
isGameEnd clears the winnerloser history.
setwinnerLimit guards with assert(msg.sender == owner).
Owner supplied x becomes the new winnerLimit threshold.
Privileged write of the winnerLimit state variable.
getter returns ownerofCountry.
getter returns totalmoney.
getaddr reads playerCountries[ax][bx].
len reads the length of playerCountries[ax].
lastrandom returns lastR.
getwinnerloser returns the winnerloser array.
lastgamewinner returns lastgameendWinner.

normalization_plan.reason: Pure input parameter used only to select the country slot inside buyCountry.
Pure input parameter whose only role is to pick the target country in attackCountry.
Transient argument that is immediately stored into winnerLimit by the owner-only setter.
Temporary alias of msg.sender scoped to attackCountry.
Temporary address read from ownerofCountry and only used inside attackCountry.
Loop bound local fully contained in the country transfer logic of attackCountry.
Scratch address used only to compute the payout recipient inside isGameEnd.
Local copy of playerList.length used solely for the isGameEnd scan.
